already_known: Prior publication analyzed independent monarch egg, larva, adult and milkweed abundances; raw data have not been inspected here.
initial_task: Download metadata and allowed open files and audit schema; never compute coefficients from incomplete survey units.
intended_primary: Stage (egg vs larva) x nonnative milkweed fraction association, adjusted for route, month, total milkweeds, survey exposure.
prior_literature_boundary: Published paper contains separate stage models. Any interaction is exploratory and can repeat prior biology.
failure: If raw files inaccessible or no comparable counts/denominators, stop without fitting or assuming counts.
biological_claims_not_allowed: monarch findings generalized to other butterflies
action_limit: Do not modify GEB main manuscript
